honesty: Zero-inflated structured synthetic Poisson counts measure the engineering envelope (throughput, memory) of the kernel stages. This is not biological validity and not a clinical performance claim. The committed run records its exact machine and memory class: a small-node run is not an HPC number. HPC reproduction: sbatch cluster/slurm/profiles/run_scale_benchmark.sbatch. Peak memory uses ru_maxrss on POSIX and the Windows peak working set elsewhere; the method is recorded alongside the value.
